short_description: Free electronic claims clearinghouse with 5,000+ payer connections, plus optional low-cost practice management and EHR modules.
long_description: Office Ally Service Center is one of the most popular free clearinghouses in healthcare, used by over 80,000 providers to submit electronic claims. The Service Center offers free electronic claims submission to thousands of payers nationwide, with claims typically processed within 24-48 hours. The platform includes free ERA (electronic remittance advice) receipt, real-time claim status checking, and eligibility verification (at a small per-transaction fee). Office Ally also offers companion products including Practice Mate (free practice management), Patient Ally (patient portal), and an EHR solution. The company was acquired by Availity in 2020, expanding its payer network and stability. Office Ally is particularly popular with mental health practices using EHRs like SimplePractice, TheraNest, and others that route claims through Office Ally's clearinghouse.

faqs.q: Is Office Ally really free for claims submission?
faqs.a: Yes, Office Ally Service Center provides free unlimited electronic claims submission. There are no per-claim fees, monthly fees, or setup fees for basic claims submission. Optional features like eligibility verification ($0.34/check) and ERA auto-posting have small fees, but core claims submission remains free.

faqs.q: What's the difference between Office Ally and Availity?
faqs.a: Office Ally was acquired by Availity in 2020 but continues to operate as a separate brand. Office Ally focuses on free and low-cost solutions for small practices, while Availity offers more comprehensive (and typically more expensive) RCM solutions. The acquisition expanded Office Ally's payer network and backend stability.

faqs.q: Does Office Ally work with mental health EHRs like SimplePractice?
faqs.a: Many mental health EHRs including SimplePractice, TheraNest, and others use Office Ally as one of their clearinghouse partners for claims submission. This means your claims may route through Office Ally even if you don't directly use their interface. Check with your EHR about their clearinghouse partnerships.

faqs.q: How long does it take for Office Ally claims to reach payers?
faqs.a: Office Ally typically processes and transmits claims to payers within 24-48 hours of submission. Claim status updates are available in real-time through the Service Center portal. Actual payment timing depends on individual payer processing times.
